body.en:
Question B-001-022-004.

Why the correct answer is right: Amateur Radio Operator Certificate qualification examinations at an ISED office are no charge in the current bank.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "$20 per visit, regardless of the number of qualification examinations": ISED office exams are not charged by visit.
- sourceIndex 2: "$20 per qualification": ISED office exams are not charged by qualification.
- sourceIndex 3: "$5 per qualification examination": ISED office exams have no charge, so a five-dollar per-qualification fee is still a fee where the bank gives none.
